3.measure_note: NOT the county's printed schedule — this page is the CANDIDATE'S OWN typed ledger headed 'Contributions Received', so rowbands.py returns ZERO printed rules on it (the §A2 recovery applies). Bands were recovered with `rowbands.py <pdf> 3 --text-lines --col 76,93`, restricted to the amount column: it returns exactly 5 text bands — 14.64 (the printed 'Amount' header), 16.46 / 18.23 / 19.96 (the three entries) and 22.00 (the printed 'Total Contributions' line) — i.e. header + 3 rows + total, which independently confirms the row count. Each band is stored padded 0.25 pct either side. Column bands are read off the ledger's own header underlines and are PROVENANCE ONLY, approximate: this page carries +0.8 deg of skew, so a band measured in the amount column does NOT transfer across the sheet (§A2); only the amount band is load-bearing and it is the one that was proved. PROOF CROPS at 900 dpi: row 1 pct:78.5,16.21,12.5,1.45@p3 rendered '$ 4,000.00' (recorded 4000.00); row 3 pct:76.0,19.71,16.0,1.45@p3 rendered '$ 5,306.51' with the ledger's own rule beneath it (recorded 5306.51); and the §B5 ONE-PAST-THE-END negative control pct:76.0,21.75,16.0,1.45@p3 rendered '$ 15,958.71' — the printed TOTAL line, not a fourth entry, which is exactly the proof that the row list ends at row 3.

notes: A NEW SOURCE PROPERTY FOR THE WAVE, and the 2014 analogue of Addendum A §A2: THE COUNTY'S COVER SHEET WITH THE CANDIDATE'S OWN TYPED SUMMARY AND SCHEDULES BEHIND IT. p1 IS the county's printed 2014 blank ('2014 FINANCIAL CAMPAIGN REPORT FOR COUNTY & LOCAL SCHOOL BOARD CANDIDATES'), completed in pencil/grey ink; p2, p3 and p4 are NOT the county's Summary Page / Schedule A / Schedule B at all but three sheets the filer produced herself in a spreadsheet, headed 'Summary Page', 'Contributions Received' and 'Expenditures Made'. THE SIDES ARE STILL `transcribed` — what is missing is the county's FORM, not the filer's entries (§A2 governs; this is NOT a no-schedule-page). THE LABELS MAP ONE-TO-ONE and that is what makes the per-period anchor safe: her summary's 'This Period' column IS the legacy Column A slot and her 'Year to Date' column IS Column B, and beneath them she reproduces the legacy ladder line for line (Balance at Beginning of Reporting Period / Total Contributions Received / Subtotal / Total Expenditures Made / Balance at Close of Reporting Period) — only the printed line NUMBERS 1-7 are absent. Her schedules also keep the county's own column captions verbatim ('Name of Contributor', 'Mailing Address & Zip Code', 'Amount'), except that Schedule B's payee column is captioned 'Name of Recipient' rather than the county blank's 'Purchased From/Source'. NEITHER of her ledgers has a Purpose column, but she appends the purpose after a hyphen inside the recipient cell on 15 of 16 expenditure rows — the FIRST filing in this chunk from which a purpose can be read at all. FOLIATION: none — no page-of-page box, no page numbers; each of her three sheets is self-identifying by its own printed heading plus her name and the report date '10/28/2014'. This is a further reason the summary page must be located by CONTENT. PAGE-FACE candidate 'Kim Jackson' (Republican, Orem); index.csv names no candidate, so the page face supplies it. Office written on the cover simply as 'Treasurer', which is compatible with (and narrower than) the channel's 'County Treasurer' — recorded, not adjudicated. Report type ticked 'Seven days preceding the General Election'; amendment 'No' ticked; signed and dated 10/28/2014; clerk's date stamp is a faint sideways impression on p1. THIS FILING IS NOT REDACTED — its raw filename carries no '_Redacted' suffix and the county published the candidate's own address block and every donor and vendor address in the clear; the privacy reduction to city/state is therefore mine at READ TIME, exactly as Addendum A §A5 requires, and NOT the county's.
